info.name: OpenAQ Get a location by ID

params.name: locations_id
params.description: Limit the results to a specific location by id

items.docs: Provides a location by location ID

params.name: coordinates
params.description: WGS 84 Coordinate pair in form latitude,longitude. Supports up to 4 decimal points of precision, additional decimal precision will be truncated in the query e.g. 38.9074,-77.0373

params.name: radius
params.description: Search radius from coordinates as center in meters. Maximum of 25,000 (25km) defaults to 1000 (1km) e.g. radius=1000

params.name: providers_id
params.description: Limit the results to a specific provider or multiple providers  with a single provider ID or a comma delimited list of IDs

params.name: limit
params.description:
Change the number of results returned.
        e.g. limit=100 will return up to 100 results

params.name: page
params.description: Paginate through results. e.g. page=1 will return first page of results

params.name: owner_contacts_id
params.description: Limit the results to a specific owner by owner ID with a single owner ID or comma delimited list of IDs

params.name: order_by
params.description: The field by which to order results

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Sort results ascending or descending. Default ASC

params.name: monitor
params.description: Is the location considered a reference monitor?

params.name: mobile
params.description: Is the location considered a mobile location?

params.name: iso
params.description: Limit the results to a specific country using ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code

params.name: countries_id
params.description: Limit the results to a specific country or countries by country ID as a single country ID or a comma delimited list of IDs

params.name: bbox
params.description: geospatial bounding box of Min X, min Y, max X, max Y in WGS 84 coordinates. Up to 4 decimal points of precision, addtional decimal precision will be truncated to 4 decimal points precision e.g. -77.037,38.907,-77.0,39.910

info.name: OpenAQ Get a location by ID

params.name: location_id
params.description: The ID of the location

params.name: limit
params.description: Change the number of results returned. e.g. limit=1000 will return up to 1000 results

params.description: Paginate through results. e.g. page=1 will return first page of results

params.name: sort

items.docs: Provides a location by location ID

params.name: limit
params.description: Change the number of results returned. e.g. limit=1000 will return up to 1000 results

params.name: page
params.description: Paginate through results. e.g. page=1 will return first page of results

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort Direction e.g. sort=desc

params.name: parameter_id
params.description: (optional) A parameter ID to filter measurement results. e.g. parameter_id=2 (i.e. PM2.5) will limit measurement results to only PM2.5 measurements

params.name: parameter
params.description: (optional) A parameter name or ID by which to filter measurement results. e.g. parameter=pm25 or parameter=pm25&parameter=pm10

params.name: coordinates
params.description: Coordinate pair in form lat,lng. Up to 8 decimal points of precision e.g. 38.907,-77.037

params.name: radius
params.description: Search radius from coordinates as center in meters. Maximum of 25,000 (25km) defaults to 1000 (1km) e.g. radius=10000

params.name: country_id
params.description: Limit results by a certain country using two digit country ID. e.g. 13

params.name: country
params.description: Limit results by a certain country using two letter country code. e.g. ?country=US or ?country=US&country=MX

params.name: city
params.description: Limit results by a certain city or cities. (e.g. ?city=Chicago or ?city=Chicago&city=Boston)

params.name: order_by
params.description: Order by a field

params.name: is_mobile
params.description: Location is mobile e.g. ?isMobile=true

params.name: is_analysis
params.description: Data is the product of a previous analysis/aggregation and not raw measurements e.g. ?isAnalysis=true

params.name: source_name
params.description: Name of the data source e.g. ?sourceName=Houston%20Mobile

params.name: entity
params.description: Source entity type. e.g. ?entity=government

params.name: sensor_type
params.description: Type of Sensor e.g. ?sensorType=reference%20grade

params.name: model_name
params.description: Model Name of Sensor e.g. ?modelName=AE33

params.name: manufacturer_name
params.description: Manufacturer of Sensor e.g. ?manufacturer=Ecotech
